<a id="what-comparison-principle-c-ranks-under-each-reading--比较原则-c-在各读法下的排序"></a>
# What comparison principle C ranks under each reading

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`ranking-under-readings` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F07 · [record](ranking-under-readings.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For every family of courses, a law says exactly when a renewing course extends another under either living reading. Stepwise C keeps sharing above winning by consumption and restraint above overdraw, not the absence of an overdrawer included before the loss; the possibility reading keeps all three.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Taking two continuations as the configurations of a frame and the events a reading includes as its realized claims, comparison principle C is Comparison on that frame. The whole-run reading includes the events that are active and not consuming in that continuation, the stepwise reading those that are active and not undermining. (`Becoming.Ranking.frame`, `Becoming.Ranking.ExtendsUnder`, `Becoming.Ranking.ComparisonUnder`, `Becoming.Extension`, `Becoming.Comparison`, `Becoming.Ranking.wholeRun`, `Becoming.Ranking.stepwise`)
2. The law of comparison with a renewing course, for every family of courses: under either reading, a course that renews every condition (meets every need at every step) extends another exactly when it is active at every event the other includes and at some event the other withholds; where every formation is active at every step of it, exactly when the other withholds some event. (`Becoming.Ranking.renewed_extends_iff`, `Becoming.Ranking.renewed_active_extends_iff`, `Becoming.Ranking.extendsUnder_iff_of_exact`, `Becoming.Ranking.wholeRun_of_renewed`, `Becoming.Ranking.stepwise_of_renewed`)
3. The whole-run law of easing, for every family of courses: from a course where activity needs support to one that asks no dependence or need more, holds every condition at least as high, draws on nothing more and is active wherever supported, no event the whole-run reading includes is withdrawn, so the second extends the first exactly when it includes an event the first withholds. (`Becoming.Ranking.wholeRun_extends_iff_of_eases`, `Becoming.Ranking.wholeRun_mono`, `Becoming.Ranking.Eases`, `Becoming.Ranking.ActiveWhereSupported`)
4. Under the stepwise reading the renewal in the law of comparison cannot be dropped, and easing alone gives no law of easing: the law needs that the easing course undermine no event the other includes (record stepwise-law-of-easing). (`Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.renewal_needed`, `Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.stepwise_not_monotone`, `Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.over_le_stops`)
5. For any reading that includes only active events, the continuation without a formation extends the continuation with it only if the reading withholds every event of that formation. (`Becoming.Ranking.withheld_of_extends`)
6. Under the whole-run reading, for every law of the support-gated family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal, the continuation without it renews every condition and extends the continuation with it, an instance of the law of comparison, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher. (`Becoming.Ranking.whole_run_extends`, `Becoming.Ranking.whole_run_ranks`, `Becoming.Ranking.absent_renews`, `Becoming.Ranking.Course`, `Becoming.Ranking.course`, `Becoming.Ranking.absent`, `Becoming.Ranking.undisturbed`, `Becoming.Ranking.undisturbed_sustains`, `Becoming.Ranking.absent_sustains`, `RelationalRenewal.Law.overdraw_consuming`)
7. Under the stepwise reading an event of the focal formation is included when it is active and every need is still met after its step; the two continuations then do not extend each other, and an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with the formation. Malignant growth and winning by consumption are instances. (`Becoming.Ranking.included_before_loss`, `Becoming.Ranking.stepwise_unranked`, `Becoming.Ranking.preferOccurs`, `Becoming.Ranking.preferOccurs_only`, `Becoming.Ranking.admits_occurrence`, `Becoming.Ranking.readings_rank_differently`, `Becoming.Ranking.malignant_ranking`, `Becoming.Ranking.winning_ranking`, `RelationalRenewal.Law.malignant`, `RelationalRenewal.Law.winning`)
8. Under the stepwise reading the winner's events before the loss are included and those after are not, while sharing renews every condition and is active at every event, so sharing still extends winning by consumption, an instance of the law of comparison. (`Becoming.Ranking.Contest`, `Becoming.Ranking.contest`, `Becoming.Ranking.sharing_included`, `Becoming.Ranking.stepwise_contest`, `RelationalRenewal.Law.sharing`, `RelationalRenewal.Law.within_renewal_sustains`)
9. Under both readings a continuation in which every need stays met and every formation is active (restraint) extends every continuation that withholds some event, an instance of the law of comparison. (`Becoming.Ranking.Restraint`, `Becoming.Ranking.restraint`, `Becoming.Ranking.stops_included`, `Becoming.Ranking.renewed_active_extends_iff`)
10. In the two-part family meeting every need makes every formation active, and overdraw that ends the sustaining formation's support withholds its later events, so every comparison satisfying C ranks restraint higher, even though the stepwise reading includes the overdrawing formation's events before the loss; so it is for malignant growth against the same formation stopping after its first step, before the threshold. (`Becoming.Ranking.restraint_ranks`, `Becoming.Ranking.malignant_restraint`, `Becoming.Ranking.stoppingMalignant`, `Becoming.Ranking.stoppingMalignant_level`)
11. When no focal event is included, as when the first step already crosses support, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher. (`Becoming.Ranking.Immediate.focal_withheld`, `Becoming.Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence`)
12. When a third formation shares the condition, a restrained formation's later draw can undermine the third formation's once-met dependence, and under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other; that restrained course leaves the third formation's need unmet, and under the whole-run reading it still extends overdraw, by the law of easing. (`Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.focal_three`, `Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise`, `Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.stepwise_not_monotone`)
13. A third reading, the possibility reading, includes a formation where a course's levels admit it, active or not; in a dependent course it includes every active formation. (`Becoming.Ranking.possible`, `Becoming.Ranking.possible_of_active`, `Becoming.Web.Admits`)
14. The course without the focal formation admits every formation at every step; in every law of the family in which the focal formation draws beyond renewal from some step on, the course without it extends the course with it under this reading, so every comparison satisfying C ranks the former higher. (`Becoming.Ranking.absent_admits_all`, `Becoming.Ranking.possible_extends`, `Becoming.Ranking.possible_ranks`)
15. Both courses of a law have the same requirements, so under the continuation condition (Unrestricted) extension under the possibility reading is retaining and adding what has significance on the law's web. (`Becoming.Ranking.possible_course_iff`, `Becoming.Ranking.possible_extends_iff`, `Becoming.Unrestricted`, `Becoming.Web.Retains`, `Becoming.Web.Adds`)
16. Malignant growth: the possibility reading ranks the absence higher and includes the first event, as the stepwise reading includes it and the whole-run reading withholds it. (`Becoming.Ranking.malignant_possible`)
17. Under the possibility reading sharing extends winning by consumption; in the two-part family a course in which every need stays met extends a course in which overdraw ends the sustaining formation's support; with a third formation sharing the condition restraint still extends overdraw, where the stepwise reading leaves them unranked. (`Becoming.Ranking.possible_contest`, `Becoming.Ranking.possible_restraint`, `Becoming.Ranking.ThirdParty.possible_extends`)
18. A formation drawing within renewal adds no possibility: the two courses admit the same formations and neither extends the other, while both readings of living rank its presence higher; sharing is an instance. (`Becoming.Ranking.possible_tie`, `Becoming.Ranking.readings_rank_presence`, `Becoming.Ranking.sharing_presence`)
19. Generally a level path nowhere lower includes the other and is never ranked below by retaining and adding. (`Becoming.Web.Includes.of_le`, `Becoming.Web.not_added_of_le`, `Becoming.Web.Includes.retains`, `Becoming.Web.Retains.not_added`, `Becoming.Web.Admits.mono`)
20. Possibilities first (possibilities first, and with the same possibilities a reading's included events) satisfies C under the possibility reading and is irreflexive and transitive; whatever the second reading, it ranks the absence of an overdrawing formation higher, and with either reading of living second it ranks the presence of a formation drawing within renewal above its absence. (`Becoming.Ranking.possibleFirst`, `Becoming.Ranking.possibleFirst_order`, `Becoming.Ranking.possibleFirst_overdraw`, `Becoming.Ranking.possibleFirst_presence`)
21. In a witness a supported formation resting at step 0 admits the same formations as uninterrupted activity, and possibilities first ranks the rest below. (`Becoming.Ranking.Pause.courses`, `Becoming.Ranking.Pause.pause_ranked_below`)
22. Restraint over any number of drawers, under the whole-run reading: two balanced flows from levels at least as high at the start, the restrained one taking no more from each condition and giving no less at every step, hold every condition at least as high at every step, and with dependences, needs and draws no greater the restrained course eases the other; so where activity needs support in the overdrawing course and follows support in the restrained one, the restrained course extends the other exactly when it includes an event the other withholds, and every comparison satisfying C ranks it higher. No count of formations enters; TwoDrawers is an instance with two drawers and a third formation depending. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.level_succ_le`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.level_le_of_restrained`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.eases_of_restrained`, `Becoming.Ranking.restraint_extends_iff`, `Becoming.Ranking.restraint_ranks_over_drawers`, `Becoming.TwoDrawers.restraint_ranks`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- C is a disclosed comparison premise, not proved here; it occurs only as a hypothesis or a definition. The continuation without the focal formation is the one of relational-reading-comparison, its levels given by the same law when the focal formation does not occur.
- The stepwise conclusion needs an active step of the focal formation after which every need is still met; the premises of the support-gated family (positive need, focal need within the sustaining need, a start supporting the sustaining formation, drawing beyond renewal from some step on) are those of relational-renewal-classification.
- The restraint conclusion is proved only in the two-part family (the focal and the sustaining formation) and for a stopping law that meets every need at every step; with one more formation sharing the condition it can fail (ThirdParty).
- The possibility reading and possibilities first are definitions; possible_extends_iff takes the axiom Unrestricted as a hypothesis, and the other conclusions of the possibility reading do not use it; the possibility reading coincides with retaining and adding only for two courses of one law.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The comparisons of absence with presence and sharing with winning are proved in the support-gated family (two parts: the focal and the sustaining formation), as instances of the laws of comparison and easing. Restraint is proved for any number of drawers under the whole-run reading (Becoming.JointDraw); under the stepwise reading where it takes within what it gives (record stepwise-law-of-easing).
- The relation-level reading beyond easing and restraint: record relation-level-law-of-easing states those.
- Yields no responsibility, duty or feasibility.
- Chooses no reading.
- The possibility reading counts what can form, not what does, so it leaves a presence adding no possibility unranked. Witness: `Becoming.Ranking.possible_tie`.
- Possibilities first is a further premise, and it ranks a rest below activity. Witness: `Becoming.Ranking.Pause.pause_ranked_below`.
- **Counterexample:** Under the stepwise reading C does not decide between malignant growth and its absence (malignant_ranking): an irreflexive, transitive comparison satisfying C prefers the continuation with it. This does not say the occurrence is better, only that C alone is insufficient. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Ranking.lean)
- **Counterexample:** When no focal event is included, the stepwise reading too ranks the absence higher (Ranking.Immediate.stepwise_ranks_absence): a formation whose first step already crosses support ranks below its absence under both readings, so what the stepwise reading gives up concerns only formations with an included event before the loss. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Ranking.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The restraint conclusion does not extend to a third co-drawer (Ranking.ThirdParty.restraint_unranked_stepwise): a third formation is supported only at level 7; in the restrained course the level reaches 7 once and the restrained formation's later draw undermines the third formation's once-met dependence, while in the overdrawing course the third formation is never met and the same event is included (ThirdParty.focal_three); under the stepwise reading neither course extends the other, and extension itself is a comparison satisfying C that does not rank restraint higher; under the whole-run reading restraint still extends overdraw. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Ranking.lean)
- **Counterexample:** An independent review: every declaration under review is accepted with empty axiom reports; MetSince had to compare the need at that step (repaired), a one-step lapse starts a new tenure (disclosed), and but-for needs the move to be available (repaired); the prose overclaimed on what the stepwise reading gives up, restraint, substitution, interaction and the remaining connection that needs no actual drawing (corrected in the integration note). [source](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/BECOMING-P8-P9-P7B-REVIEW.md)
- **Counterexample:** The possibility reading leaves presence within renewal unranked against absence (Ranking.possible_tie, Ranking.sharing_presence): both readings of living rank the presence higher, the possibility reading neither. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Relevance.lean)
- **Counterexample:** What possibilities first gives up (Ranking.Pause.pause_ranked_below): a rest that adds no possibility is ranked below uninterrupted activity. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Relevance.lean)

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The two rankings part ways under the stepwise reading. If G0 and C share the stepwise reading, C still ranks sharing above winning by consumption but no longer ranks the continuation without malignant growth higher; the whole-run reading keeps both but does not meet the independent review's criteria (b) and (c). If G0 takes the stepwise reading and C the whole-run reading, both are kept, but G0 and C no longer share one reading of living: formally each takes its reading as a parameter, while the premise card reads C's “living content” as G0's living, so a split must be disclosed. 生生 reads as generation generating generation, its direction compared by widening what can form (DELEGATED-CHOICES D1, revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026). The interpretation of the possibility reading (an AI argument, adopted on Ren's delegation): it reads “what has significance is what can form” and Ren's “more possibilities of becoming”; it counts what can form, not what does. Under the axiom C is read on possibilities, and the ranking comes from what the part loses, not from discounting the formation itself; Ren left the comparison of courses to the AI on 11 October 2026 (“Comparing courses - you decide”): courses are compared on possibilities, for the reasons in chapter section 6.5.
